old_mapping_after_clean_transition.definition: split/merge; no fault/rate/stale coordinator; floor correct; response observed; same incarnation; old-mapping writer; GC none/target
old_mapping_after_clean_transition.hash_remap_no_epoch: 4/4 accepts stale old-mapping write and 4/4 creates duplicate reservation; GC-target half of the slice deletes a live root
old_mapping_after_clean_transition.forwarding_tombstone: 0 stale old-mapping write in this clean committed slice; old mapping is forwarded/rejected
old_mapping_after_clean_transition.topology_prepared_committed_inherit: 0 stale write, 0 duplicate reservation, 0 live-root deletion; old topology generation is rejected
old_mapping_after_clean_transition.dual_read_migration: 4/4 accepts old-mapping write and creates duplicate reservation because both maps remain writable

early_new_mapping_during_prepared_fault.definition: split/merge; crash after topology PREPARE; new-mapping writer; correct floor; no rate/stale coordinator; response observed; same incarnation; GC varies
early_new_mapping_during_prepared_fault.forwarding_tombstone: 4/4 early new-mapping write accepted while topology is not committed; duplicate reservation in this blocked migration
early_new_mapping_during_prepared_fault.topology_prepared_committed_inherit: 0 early write/duplicate; new mapping requires COMMITTED topology generation and the PREPARED state remains recoverable

floor_reset_or_merge_min.definition: split/merge clean control path except floor transition resets/uses min; old-mapping writer; no rate/stale; response observed; same incarnation; GC varies
floor_reset_or_merge_min.forwarding_tombstone: commits topology despite lowered floor; stale old authority accepted and GC-target half can delete live root
floor_reset_or_merge_min.topology_prepared_committed_inherit: 0 unsafe effect; transition stays PREPARED/blocked because split children must inherit >= parent floor and merge output >= max input floor

one_domain_rate_limited.definition: rate limit on left or right domain; other axes restricted to no fault, correct floor, observed response, current coordinator; operation/write/incarnation/GC vary
one_domain_rate_limited.forwarding_tombstone: 32/32 migration blocked with stranded/orphan forwarding state in the model
one_domain_rate_limited.topology_prepared_committed_inherit: 32/32 nonterminal recoverable PREPARED; old topology remains authoritative and no cross-topology stale/duplicate/live-GC effect is accepted

scope_safe_conclusion.mapping_rule: A deterministic hash/path remap is routing, not authority. Every write/GC action must bind to a monotonic topology generation and reject a retired mapping even if that old path still exists.
scope_safe_conclusion.prepare_commit_rule: Topology mutation is PREPARED while new child/merge domains are provisioned. New-mapping writes require current COMMITTED generation; old mapping remains authoritative until COMMIT. COMMIT occurs only after all new domains are present, floor inheritance is proven, and current coordinator/topology epoch still matches.
scope_safe_conclusion.floor_rule: Split child floor >= parent floor; merge output floor >= max(input floors). Reset/min transitions fail closed and remain PREPARED rather than lowering stale-writer fences.
scope_safe_conclusion.forwarding_rule: A forwarding tombstone is useful after COMMIT to reject/redirect old paths, but it is not itself a transaction coordinator. Installing forwarding before new mapping/floors are committed can strand traffic or admit early writes.
scope_safe_conclusion.response_rate_rule: Applied-response-lost topology COMMIT is reconciled by current topology generation/transition ID. Rate limit on one domain leaves PREPARED recoverable and does not make a partial topology authoritative.
scope_safe_conclusion.incarnation_rule: Target incarnation generation from Part61 remains part of the reservation/floor comparison across topology moves; physical shard identity alone is not sufficient.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.repository_transport: role-local topology intent/generation + shard floor/ref/path/CAS/readback only

frontier: Topology PREPARED cleanup/rollback: abort a split/merge after one child provisioned while late writers and GC continue; require old mapping authority restoration without lowering floors or deleting new-generation reservations.
Cross-topology promotion intent: promotion PREPARED under G1 while topology G2 commits; decide whether promotion is remapped, aborted, or bridges both generations without duplicate reservation.
exact_continuation: Model topology-abort cleanup. Start topology G2 PREPARED with one child provisioned and floor inherited. Compare delete-child-then-abort, abort-generation-then-fenced-child-cleanup, forwarding-only rollback, monotonic topology ABORTED + exact child-generation cleanup, and fail-closed. Adversaries: late G2 child write, late G1 parent write, response loss, target reuse, stale coordinator, rate limit, GC, and a concurrent promotion intent. Measure post-abort G2 resurrection, stale cleanup of reused child reservation, duplicate cross-generation reservation, live-root deletion, stranded child state, false blockage, and recovery reads.
